name: @oh-dsh/desktop
description: Oh-DSH: installable Desktop, Web, and TUI surfaces over DeepSeek Harness
author: dsh-external

scripts.ohdsh: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh && node dist/ohdsh.js
scripts.web: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh && node dist/web.js
scripts.tui: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh && node dist/ohdsh.js tui
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh && electron .
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter lcov --test-reporter-destination coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter spec --test-reporter-destination stdout tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-mac.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-mac.mjs x64
scripts.dist:mac:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-mac.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-linux.mjs
scripts.dist:linux:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-linux.mjs
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-windows.mjs
scripts.dist:win:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface desktop && node scripts/build-windows.mjs
scripts.dist:web: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface web && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.dist:web:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface web && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.dist:tui: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:dsh && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface tui && node scripts/build-tui.mjs
scripts.dist:tui:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:dsh -- --surface tui && node scripts/build-tui.mjs

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Oh-DSH Desktop uses Apple Events only when a DeepSeek Harness tool needs to interact with a Mac app.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Oh-DSH Desktop needs access to workspaces you select on the Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Oh-DSH Desktop needs access to workspaces you select in Documents.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Oh-DSH Desktop needs access to workspaces you select in Downloads.

linux.synopsis: An extensible DeepSeek Harness desktop workbench
